metadata.scope: Step 6: SetA-01 through SetA-20, runs 1 through 10
metadata.seed_rule: seed_base + run = 1000 + run; expected seeds 1001 through 1010 per instance
metadata.route_equality: Exact equality of sorted (demand id, period, ordered waypoint tuple) assignments; JSON array order is ignored. Physical ECMP subpaths are not counted as independently chosen routes.
metadata.load_equality: Exact numerical equality of the entire saved sorted_loads tuple after JSON parsing; no rounding or tolerance clustering.
metadata.mlu_equality: Exact numerical equality of the saved scalar objective after JSON parsing.
metadata.evidence_limit: Saved command/configuration/result/supervisor provenance is checked. Different timing/node/trace records support separate executions; this is not a new runtime readback of the solver RNG or a rerun. Unique trace hashes can reflect timestamps or measurements, not necessarily different search paths.
